d: Guyana's President Irfaan Ali has shot back at the Trump administration over Essequibo. This comes days after an official working under Secretary of State Marco Rubio reportedly repeatedly urged Guyanese officials to cede Essequibo territory to Venezuela. Irfaan Ali has stated that Essequibo is Guyanese territory and no land compromises will be made. Venezuela has for decades claimed Essequibo as its own territory, a rhetoric that was ramped up when Nicolas Maduro was the President of Venezuela.
